title: Design: Retired number typed in a lookup shows the inactive line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, whose part number has capital letters.
  • Create an open work order for this test, work order 1, with one line.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 6.3 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part in the Parts row of its line.
  3. Type part A's full part number in lower case in the Part Number box.
  4. Click the X at the top right of the New Part Request window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The New Part Request window opens.

Step 3:

  • The open lookup list holds one line of dark text: part A's number in capitals, as stocked, followed by "is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."
  • That line is the only one in the list: no special-order row and no option to add the number.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and the line's Parts row still shows only Add Part: no part was added.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R16: “When the number typed in a part lookup matches an inactive part at this location, the lookup does not offer to add it as a special order. It shows "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", naming the inactive part's number. On technician charge-out, where a typed number is taken straight from the field, the field shows the same message as its error and the line cannot be saved.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Retired number typed in a part lookup | "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." | Shown in the lookup in place of the special order offer; on technician charge-out, error under the field”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
